rationale: Water damage originated from the policyholder's own plumbing and caused structural and contents damage to their own home, fitting squarely within property_damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from a work trip to find their entire basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water due to a plumbing failure. Damage includes buckled hardwood floors, drywall soaked up to 1 foot high throughout the basement, and ruined stored contents. Severity assessed as HIGH — likely exceeds $25,000 and requires urgent on-site remediation assessment to prevent mold.

case_facts.description: Returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water across the entire basement. Hardwood floor is buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot high, and stored boxes are ruined.
case_facts.water_source: Own plumbing failure (not external or neighbor-caused)
case_facts.damage_items: Buckled hardwood floors, soaked drywall (up to 1 foot), ruined stored boxes/contents

rationale: Storm debris caused damage to the garage roof, fence, and parked car across the policyholder's property; while a neighbor's shed may be partly involved, the primary presenting claim is storm/wind damage to the policyholder's own structures and vehicle, with a possible liability subrogation angle to investigate on-site.
claim_summary: Policyholder Avery Santos (POL-1008) reports major overnight storm damage to their property with three confirmed damage points: (1) parked car struck by debris, (2) garage roof damaged, and (3) a section of fence destroyed. Source of debris is unconfirmed — either a tree or parts of the neighbor's shed — so a subrogation/liability angle must be investigated on-site. Emergency services were still present at time of call and a full property walk has not been completed; total damage extent is unknown but expected to be high. Auto coverage is also active and the vehicle damage should be assessed concurrently.

rationale: Wind-caused shingle loss to the policyholder's own roof is a clear structural property damage event with no theft, liability, or auto elements.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports that wind last weekend blew approximately four shingles off the overhang above the back porch. No interior water damage or injuries were reported. Estimated repair cost is $400 — note this is below the $2,500 deductible, so the adjuster should confirm coverage applicability with the claimant before proceeding.

case_facts.description: Approximately four shingles blown off; no interior water damage or leaking
